summary_1line: Bhishma, nearing death, tells Yudhishthira that Krishna embodies the cosmic creator and sustainer, urging him to learn remaining dharma from Krishna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows speaking to Yudhishthira while the assembled warriors listen and Krishna stands nearby.
Krishna lifts the Govardhana mountain above the cowherds of Vrindavana as torrential rain sent by Indra crashes down.
From Krishna’s navel a lotus rises and Brahma appears within it at the dawn of creation.
